name: M2RAG
description: M2RAG is a benchmark designed to evaluate Multi-modal Large Language Models' ability to leverage knowledge from multi-modal retrieval documents. It includes four open-domain tasks: image captioning, multi-modal question answering, multi-modal fact verification, and image reranking.
reputation: A specialized multimodal retrieval benchmark with limited but growing use in evaluating retrieval-augmented multimodal LLMs.
notes: Focuses on retrieval-augmented generation in multi-modal contexts; includes an instruction tuning method (MM-RAIT) to improve MLLM performance.
